svg.text: Role/Battle review fixes and submission gate
Deep review closed the persistence, lifecycle, authority, routing, and smoke-fixture gaps in the pending change set
Before: independent or bypassable paths
After: guarded, durable paths
Login and respawn
Prepared profile remained reusable after login.
Respawn could reapply a stale pre-mutation snapshot.
Logout could observe incomplete initialization.
Purchase persistence
Player and world records were not one commit boundary.
A persistence failure could leave an in-memory purchase.
Dormant merchant state was easy to lose at respawn.
Authority and routing
Broom component RPCs did not identify the requesting rider.
Editor executable matching accepted broad name prefixes.
Listen hosts could bypass an unhealthy readiness state.
Smoke fixtures
Runs could inherit the Steam provider or shared save state.
Repeated tests could contaminate one another.
Zero-price definitions could disagree with runtime policy.
Login snapshot becomes one-shot
Authenticate and validate role/economy before spawn.
Save the initialized state, then clear the pending snapshot.
Logout saves only a ready profile.
Purchase → checkpoint → result
Mutate wallet, inventory, and merchant on authority.
Verify player + world records, write one manifest, then succeed.
Failure restores all state and returns PersistenceFailed/RollbackFailed.
Merchant lifecycle and restore
Death publishes unavailable; dormant stock is retained.
Respawn registration applies the validated pending stock.
Immutable definition and complete-offer checks guard restore.
Controller-owned broom authority
Every client mount/dismount enters the owning controller.
Mounted ownership, range, finite inputs, and single attachment are checked.
Editor routing uses an exact executable allowlist.
Deterministic validation harness
Explicit development provider + per-run Saved fixture directories.
Listen/Dedicated smoke paths and source contracts share the guards.
Config load rejects zero buy prices consistently with runtime.
Validation evidence
All Scripts contracts • AuraEditor Win64 Development build • Python/JSON/XML/PowerShell checks • git diff --check
Runtime evidence: Day 16 Listen/Dedicated, Day 17 Listen/Dedicated, Day 18 Listen, Day 19 Listen. Submission note: stage intended files only; restrict GSM to trusted LAN/loopback.
